html:
The Yalarrnga were an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, in the hills and creeks south of today's Mount Isa toward Dajarra.

Little is recorded of their history. Linguists wrote down their language from its last speakers in the twentieth century. Neighbours included the Kalkadoon to the north, the Yanda, Warluwarra and Pitta Pitta. Cattle stations reached the area in the 1870s and 1880s, a time of hard frontier fighting with the Kalkadoon.
sum: The Yalarrnga were an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, in the hills and creeks south of today's Mount Isa toward Dajarra.
